scan_budget.description: The most rows one `in_stats` question counts per ledger table it reads (`calls`, `marks`), ascending from `stats_from`. A window with more rows is answered with what was counted and `truncated: true`; it is never cut short in silence.

cold_cached_share.description: The share of a call's window its cached tokens must reach for the call to count as warm in the `window` figure: a call whose cached tokens stay under it is cold, and `cold_pct` is the share of cold calls among those with a window.

description.purpose: The curator counts its own ledger (GH #926): one `in_stats` question -- a tag, a window `[stats_from, stats_to)` of at most 31 days, the kinds to count, and how many samples -- answered on `stats` with the number of `calls` rows started in the window and of `marks` rows of each asked kind (`gap`, `reread`, `ask`, `correction`, `tool_error`) stamped in it, and for `window`, `rebuild` and `gc` the figures read off the `curate` and `gc` marks in it, whole numbers, and the newest of the counted marks as metadata only, their sessions and turns as references of this answer, never the ledger's ids. One ledger round trip per question, read only.
description.use_when: Inside the curator only; the parent routes `hop.route == 'in_stats'` onto the hive and takes `stats` back out of its rim, matched by `hop.stats_tag`.
description.not_in_scope: No model, no ranking, no write: deterministic counts of this hive's ledger. No text and no identity: a sample carries `at`, `kind`, a value that is metadata (a gap's words stay in the ledger) and, as `session_id` and `turn_id`, references this answer hands out (`s1`, `s1#1`, ...) -- never the ledger's own ids, which carry the channel (a phone number, a chat id). No audience: a count says nothing of what was said.
description.emits_meaning: stats: the answer, `{messages: [], stats: {from, to, counts{<kind>: int | figure}, samples[{at, kind, session_id, turn_id, value}], truncated}}` -- a sample's `session_id` and `turn_id` are references handed out per answer (`s1`, `s1#1`, ...), never the ledger's ids -- a figure is an object of whole numbers: `window` `{n, p50, p95, max, cached_pct, cold_pct, cost_cents_sum, raw_p95}` and, when the marks carry the watch of the window (GH #1463), the sums `prefix_breaks`, `window_lost` and `thinking_dropped`, `rebuild` `{n, by_mark, rate_pct}`, `gc` `{n, classes, active_pct, tool_share_pct, recall_rows_p95}`, zeros over a ledger without those marks; no sample is drawn from a figure's marks -- with `hop.stats_tag` echoed, `hop.error_code` (empty, `invalid_input`, `store_error`) and `hop.detail` (the hop key a refused question failed on for `invalid_input`; for `store_error` the ledger table whose read the store refused -- `calls`, `marks`, both comma-joined, or `ledger` when its answer names neither); a refusal carries empty `counts` and `samples`. lstore: the one bundle of ledger reads of a question.
description.consumes_meaning: in_stats (`hop.stats_tag`, `hop.stats_from`, `hop.stats_to`, `hop.stats_kinds`, `hop.stats_samples`) and the ledger's answer to its phase `count`.
